splash.subTagline: Your Personal Shield Against Digital Fraud

onboarding.slide1Desc: Analyze suspicious SMS or WhatsApp messages using Android Sharesheet, in-app paste, or screenshot scanning. ScamShield never reads your personal messages in the background.
onboarding.slide2Desc: Screen incoming unknown calls against an offline database of verified scam numbers. We never listen to call audio or record your conversations. Requires Android Call Screening permission.
onboarding.slide3Desc: Immediately dial India's National Cyber Crime Helpline (1930) or access the cybercrime portal (cybercrime.gov.in) with human-guided bank freeze preparation.

languageSelect.title: Choose Your Language
languageSelect.subtitle: Select the language you are most comfortable reading and listening to. You can change this at any time.

emergency.title: Emergency Help & Bank Freeze
emergency.subtitle: National Cyber Helpline 1930 & Instant Bank Freeze Preparation
emergency.helplineDesc: Official Indian National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
emergency.helplineCardDesc: Dial 1930 immediately if you suspect money was stolen or transferred from your account.
emergency.portalCardDesc: File an official complaint on the Government of India National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
emergency.confirmDialMessage: This will open your phone dialer to call India's official National Cyber Crime Reporting helpline 1930.
emergency.confirmPortalMessage: This will open the official Government of India cybercrime reporting portal (cybercrime.gov.in) in your web browser.
emergency.guidanceSubtitle: Follow these 4 essential steps within 2 hours if you suspect cyber fraud:
emergency.step1Desc: Call 1930 immediately. National cyber police can freeze stolen funds between bank escrow accounts before fraudsters withdraw them at ATMs.
emergency.step2Title: 2. Block Cards & UPI with Your Bank
emergency.step2Desc: Use the verified bank directory below to block cards, net banking, and UPI channels immediately.
emergency.step3Desc: Keep transaction SMS, debit alert messages, and fraud phone numbers. Do not delete them.
emergency.step4Desc: Legitimate police and bank officers will NEVER ask for your OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN, or passwords.
emergency.warningNeverShare: ⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: Legitimate bank staff, police, and helpline 1930 will NEVER ask for your OTP, UPI PIN, passwords, or card CVV. Never share credentials.
emergency.noAutoFreezeDisclaimer: ⚠️ Important: ScamShield cannot automatically freeze your account or make calls. You must call your bank or 1930 directly.
emergency.familyNoticeDesc: Quickly notify your trusted children or family members so they can assist you immediately. Tap to copy or share.
emergency.familyDetailsPlaceholder: Optional: Describe what happened (e.g. ₹5,000 debited, suspicious electricity call)
emergency.familyNoticeCopied: Family message template copied to clipboard! Paste it into WhatsApp or SMS.
emergency.bankDirectoryDesc: Call your bank's verified toll-free fraud helpline immediately to freeze your debit card, UPI, or net banking.
emergency.bankNotFoundDesc: Check the verified toll-free number printed on the back of your physical Debit Card or bank passbook. NEVER search for bank customer care numbers on Google search ads.
emergency.confirmBankDialMessage: This will open your phone dialer to call {{bankName}} at {{phoneNumber}} to block your account or card.
emergency.freezeNoticeDesc: Generate a standardized urgent notice to send to your bank branch or customer care. ScamShield NEVER sends silent messages.
emergency.bankNamePlaceholder: e.g., State Bank of India, HDFC Bank
emergency.noticeCopied: Notice copied to clipboard! Paste it into your email, SMS, or bank support ticket.
emergency.privacyGuarantee: GUARANTEE: ScamShield never sends silent SMS or interacts with your bank. You review and send the notice yourself.
emergency.errorSelectBank: Please enter or select your bank name.
emergency.errorDigits: Please enter the last 4 digits of your account or card.

familyCircle.title: Family Safety Circle
familyCircle.subtitle: Consent-Based Caregiver Protection
familyCircle.consentDesc: Connect a trusted son, daughter, or family member. They will receive high-level safety notifications if a serious scam attempt is detected on your phone.
familyCircle.consentCheckboxLabel: I give explicit permission to share high-risk scam alerts and simulator learning stats with this family member.
familyCircle.consentError: You must check the consent box to authorize invitation and alert sharing.
familyCircle.nameRequiredError: Please enter your family member's name.
familyCircle.statusNotPaired: Not Connected to a Family Member
familyCircle.pairingCodeExpires: Valid for 15 minutes. Share this code with your trusted caregiver.
familyCircle.shareCodeHint: Ask your family member to enter this code in their ScamShield Family companion app.
familyCircle.shareInviteButton: 📤 Share Invitation Code via WhatsApp / SMS
familyCircle.cloudRelayStatus: Cloud Relay Server: Offline / Local Mode. Remote push alerts require cloud relay server infrastructure. Local consent pairing code active.
familyCircle.manualConfirmDesc: If your caregiver has verified the code on their device, confirm their connection below:
familyCircle.revokeConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to disconnect {{caregiverName}}? They will no longer receive any security alerts regarding this device.
familyCircle.minimalSharingDesc: Only high-level security summaries are shared to protect your dignity and complete privacy:
familyCircle.sharedItem1: • High-Risk Threat Alerts (Blocked predatory scams only)
familyCircle.sharedItem2: • Scam Simulator Learning Progress & Reflex Score
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverSees1: • Whether ScamShield protection is active and threat database is updated.
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverSees2: • High-level alerts when a high-risk predatory scam call or message is blocked.
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverNeverSeesTitle: What your caregiver CAN NEVER see:
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverNeverSees1: • Never sees your private SMS, WhatsApp messages, or conversations.
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverNeverSees2: • Never sees your OTPs, PINs, passwords, or bank balances.
familyCircle.privacyWhatCaregiverNeverSees3: • Never tracks your location or private telephone calls.

scamSimulator.title: Scam Simulator
scamSimulator.subtitle: Interactive Fraud Recognition Practice
scamSimulator.questionLabel: What is the safest action to take?
scamSimulator.completionBannerDesc: You have successfully learned how to spot India's top 8 digital scam techniques: Electricity Cutoff threats, Fake Digital Arrest, KYC Expiry links, OTP & UPI PIN fraud, Parcel Delivery phishing, Malicious APKs, QR Code scams, and Fake Customer Care numbers.
scamSimulator.masteredDesc: You correctly recognized scam tactics in these areas:
scamSimulator.noImprovementsNeeded: 🌟 Outstanding awareness! You identified every trap correctly.
scamSimulator.practiceMorePrompt: Practice makes safety a natural reflex. Retake scenarios any time.

callGuardian.title: Call Guardian
callGuardian.subtitle: Offline Threat Screening
callGuardian.safeByDefaultDesc: Unknown callers are allowed through by default so you never miss calls from doctors, family, or legitimate delivery persons. Only verified predatory numbers in the offline database are blocked.
callGuardian.spoofingWarningDesc: Criminals can sometimes spoof or fake legitimate phone numbers. If an unknown caller claims to be your bank manager or police, hang up and call official numbers directly.
callGuardian.noAudioListenDesc: ScamShield never listens to, analyzes, or records your private telephone calls.
callGuardian.callHistoryDesc: Call history is not tracked or accessed on this device. Screening occurs strictly at the moment an incoming call rings, 100% offline.

scamLens.title: Scam Lens
scamLens.subtitle: QR Code & Document Inspector
scamLens.qrInputPlaceholder: Paste or enter decoded QR text (UPI link or website URL)...
scamLens.noPaymentWarning: CRITICAL: Scanning a QR code only SENDS money out of your account. You NEVER need to scan a QR code to receive money or get a refund.
scamLens.noAutoOpenNotice: ScamShield never automatically opens web links or initiates payments.
scamLens.documentInputPlaceholder: Type or paste text from the physical letter, electricity notice, or court summon...
scamLens.ocrUnavailableNotice: On-device camera OCR is active in APK builds. Please enter or paste the text from your paper letter or notice below.
scamLens.errorEmpty: Please enter or paste QR or document content before inspecting.

messageGuardian.title: Message Guardian
messageGuardian.subtitle: Analyze Suspicious SMS or WhatsApp
messageGuardian.inputPlaceholder: Paste or type the suspicious message here...
messageGuardian.screenshotNoticeDesc: You can share messages directly into ScamShield from WhatsApp or SMS using your phone's Share menu. You can also pick a screenshot.
messageGuardian.ocrPreparationNotice: On-device OCR is active in APK builds. You can also paste text extracted from any screenshot.
messageGuardian.privacyNote: ScamShield never reads your messages in the background. You decide what to analyze.
messageGuardian.errorEmpty: Please enter or paste a message before analyzing.
messageGuardian.errorTooLong: Message exceeds the maximum limit of 2,000 characters.

analysisResult.title: Safety Analysis Result
analysisResult.riskScoreDisclaimer: Automated rule-based heuristic score (0 to 100), not a statistical guarantee.
analysisResult.otpLegitNotice: Safety Note: An OTP was mentioned, but no malicious demand was found. Never share your OTP with anyone who calls or messages you.

voiceGuardian.title: Voice Guardian
voiceGuardian.subtitle: Speak Suspicious Messages & Listen to Safety Advice
voiceGuardian.transcriptionPlaceholder: Your spoken words will appear here. You can review and edit before analyzing.
voiceGuardian.reviewInstruction: Review the transcribed message above. ScamShield never submits your speech without your confirmation.
voiceGuardian.fallbackSubtitle: If voice input is unavailable or your surroundings are noisy, you can type or paste the message directly.
voiceGuardian.permissionRationaleDesc: ScamShield needs microphone access solely to transcribe what you say. We never record phone calls, secretly listen in the background, or save audio recordings.
voiceGuardian.permissionDeniedError: Microphone permission was denied. You can still type or paste your message below.
voiceGuardian.noAudioCallNotice: NOTE: ScamShield does not listen to incoming telephone calls. We do not claim cloned-voice or deepfake audio detection.
voiceGuardian.speechVsScamNotice: Speech-to-text turns your voice into text. Scam detection is performed by our deterministic rule-based engine.
voiceGuardian.errorEmpty: Please speak or enter a message before analyzing.
voiceGuardian.errorNetwork: Could not connect to analysis service. Please check your network connection and try again.
